record.paper_title: On some open problems in Diophantine approximation
record.context_brief: Existence of omega plus below two
record.original_question: For an integer m >= 3, let 1, theta_1, ..., theta_m be linearly independent over Z. Define psi_+(t) from the minimum of ||theta_1 x_1 + ... + theta_m x_m|| over positive integers x_i with 0 < max_i x_i <= t, and define omega_+ as the supremum of gamma such that lim inf t^gamma psi_+(t) is finite. Does there exist such a collection 1, theta_1, ..., theta_m with omega_+ < 2, already for m = 3 or even for arbitrary m >= 3?

ω+ = ω+ (Θ) = sup{γ : lim inf tγ ψ+;Θ (t) < ∞}

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $m\geq 3$ be an integer and let $\Theta=(\theta_1,\dots,\theta_m)\in\mathbb{R}^m$ be such that $1,\theta_1,\dots,\theta_m$ are linearly independent over $\mathbb{Z}$. For $t\geq 1$ define
$$\psi_+(t)=\psi_{+;\Theta}(t)=\min_{\substack{x_1,\dots,x_m\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}\\ 0<\max_i x_i\leq t}}\|\theta_1 x_1+\cdots+\theta_m x_m\|,$$
where $\|\cdot\|$ denotes the distance to the nearest integer, and set
$$\omega_+(\Theta)=\sup\{\gamma\in\mathbb{R}:\liminf_{t\to\infty} t^{\gamma}\psi_{+;\Theta}(t)<\infty\}.$$
Does there exist such a collection $1,\theta_1,\dots,\theta_m$ (with all $x_i$ restricted to be positive integers) satisfying $\omega_+(\Theta)<2$? In particular, does this hold for $m=3$, or more generally for every $m\geq 3$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a conjecture by Moshchevitin in his survey of open problems in Diophantine approximation (arXiv:1202.4539). No subsequent work appears to resolve it; related results concern only the existence of $\Theta$ with $\omega_+$ bounded away from the trivial value, not the specific threshold $<2$.

status_evidence.title: On some open problems in Diophantine approximation
status_evidence.snippet: Moshchevitin's survey listing open problems including conjectures on $\omega_+(\Theta)$.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as a conjecture in this survey of open problems.

status_evidence.title: On Diophantine approximations with positive integers: a remark to W.M.Schmidt's theorem
status_evidence.snippet: Moshchevitin's remark generalizing Schmidt's theorem on approximation with positive integers.
status_evidence.claim: Related results address the positive-integer approximation problem but do not establish $\omega_+<2$.
